'''Shrimpi cups''' were a type of food available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the war, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thief/Legends|ghost burglar]] [[Bink Kitik]] ate [[Gender/Legends|her]] way around a Shrimpi cup at a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] overlooking the [[High Card Casino]] in [[Danteel City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]].<ref name="WLA" />
